title: Randomization and Performance Improvement for Integer Optimal Control with Total Variation Regularization
summary: Mixed-integer PDE-constrained optimization problems are computationally challenging due to both the combinatorial nature of integer programming as well as evaluation of the model. Many algorithms and subsequent performance improvements have been developed to solve these problems, but they are often limited by problem size. We numerically analyze two such algorithms: SLIP and Patch-SLIP, which solve trust-region subproblems over either the full or partial domain, respectively.
